summary: UBS Group AG filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on July 29, 2026, disclosing its consolidated capital instruments and TLAC-eligible senior unsecured debt as of June 30, 2026. The filing provides a detailed list of additional tier 1 and tier 2 capital instruments, including ISINs, issue dates, outstanding amounts, and regulatory recognition amounts, under the Swiss SRB framework. This is a routine regulatory disclosure for a foreign private issuer, not a special situation. No M&A, activist, restructuring, or other corporate event is described. The filing serves as an update on capital structure and regulatory compliance, akin to a periodic report.
